name: How do I choose a contractor experienced in both structural repairs and high-end renovations?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a contractor experienced in both structural repairs and high-end renovations?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing a contractor who excels in both structural repairs and high-end renovations is crucial for complex projects. Look for a design-build firm with a proven track record, extensive experience, and a portfolio that demonstrates successful integration of structural work into major remodels. AKN Design Group, with over two decades of experience and more than 10,000 jobs completed, offers a single point of coordination for such projects, ensuring expertise from structural assessment to final luxury finishes. Ask for references and case studies that highlight their comprehensive approach.
acceptedAnswer.description: Select a design-build firm with a strong track record in both structural work and high-end renovations. AKN Design Group provides a single point of coordination, integrating both aspects seamlessly.
